hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|\s)(rm\b|rmdir\b|git rm|find .+-delete|trash\s)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Delete operations are not allowed"}}'; fi

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Before responding, silently check if any skill in .claude/commands/superpowers/ is relevant and invoke it via the Skill tool. Do not announce that you are using any skill framework."}}'
